AGENDA
  SPECIAL MEETING: GLENDALE CITY COUNCIL
  (STAFF ACCESS ONLY) MUNICIPAL SERVICES BUILDING
  633 E. Broadway, Room 105 (MSB 105)
  Glendale, CA 91206
 Welcome to Glendale City Hall. Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and
 rebroadcast throughout the week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs of the
 proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s Office. Meetings are also archived on the
 City Website for viewing anytime at http://www.glendaleca.gov/government/agendas-minutes. If you
 have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact the City
 Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE COUNCIL CHAMBER.
 In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
 language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
 are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for
 requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents related
 to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and
 are public records, will be available for review in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM
 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
 Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
 wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
 Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify
 the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City provided interpreters is not
 required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak in their native language.
  JUNE 2, 2020

Due to the evolving situation with the COVID-19 novel coronavirus and health recommendations from
the LA County Health Department, the Glendale City Council Special Meeting will be available to the
public electronically.

Due to social distancing requirements, the public will not be able to attend the meeting. The public is
encouraged to watch and participate from the safety of their homes to practice social distancing.

The meeting can be viewed:
On local cable: Charter Cable Channel 6 and AT&T U-verse Channel 99.
Streaming Online: https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/public-meeting-portal

  TYPED 6/2/2020 12:47:57 PM

 For public comments and questions during the meeting call (818) 937-8100.

City staff will be submitting these questions and comments in real time to the appropriate person
during the Glendale City Council Special Meeting.

  JUNE 2, 2020

Room 105, in said City, at 1:02 p.m. on the above date, pursuant to a call for such meeting
signed by the City Clerk of the City Council, and on file with the City Clerk, a copy of which is as
follows:
  June 1, 2020
  Date

Tuesday, June 2, 2020, in the Municipal Services Building, 633 E. Broadway, Room 105
(MSB 105), Glendale, CA 91206 to consider the following item(s) of business, to wit;
1. City Manager, re: Agenda Preview for the Meetings of Tuesday, June 9, 2020

  a. Ely Lester, Transportation and Parking Commission
3. City Manager, re: Presentations by AT&T and Charter Communications
  Regarding the Increased Demand on Broadband and Addressing Impacts to
  Service

 Written Notice of said meeting was given, which Notice consisted of a copy of the
foregoing Call, and was served on each Member of the Council not joining in the Call, and
upon the in said City not less than 24 hours before the time fixed in said Call for said
meeting, as follows:
Upon Dan Brotman  at 5:00 p.m.  June 1, 2020  Glendale, CA
Upon Paula Devine  at 5:00 p.m.  June 1, 2020  Glendale, CA
Upon Ardy Kassakhian  at 5:00 p.m.  June 1, 2020  Glendale, CA
Upon Ara Najarian  at 5:00 p.m.  June 1, 2020  Glendale, CA
Upon Vrej Agajanian  at 5:00 p.m.  June 1, 2020  Glendale, CA
Mayor Agajanian called the meeting to order at 1:02 p.m.

ROLL CALL -  All Present
  -  Report of the City Clerk of the City Council, re: Posting of Agenda. The
  Agenda for the Tuesday, June 2, 2020 Special Public Meeting of the City
  Council was posted on Monday, June 1, 2020 on the Bulletin Board
  Outside City Hall.

1. City Manager, re: Agenda Preview for the Meetings of Tuesday, June 9, 2020
  Asst. City Manager Roubik Golanian provided the preview.

2. City Manager, re: Appointment of Board and Commission Member (Brotman, 5/19/20)
  a. Ely Lester, Transportation and Parking Commission
  Moved:  Brotman
  Vote as Follows
  Ayes:  Brotman, Devine, Kassakhian, Najarian, Agajanian
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  None

Council Member Devine reappointed her Commissioners: Michael Morgan for Historic
Preservation Commission, Ashul Agrasyn for Transportation and Parking Commission,
Christopher Welch for the Design Review Board Commission, Chang Lee for Planning
Commission, Lila Ramirez for CDBG Advisory Committee, Steven Lee for Building and Fire
Board of Appeals, Tom O’Shaughnessy for Audit Committee, Sarojini Lall for Glendale Water
and Power Commission, Katharine Eberle for Parks, Recreation, & Community Services
Commission, Armine Perian for the Commission on the Status of Women, and Ara Oshagan for
Arts & Culture Commission.

3. City Manager, re: Presentations by AT&T and Charter Communications
  Regarding the Increased Demand on Broadband and Addressing Impacts to
  Service
  AT&T Rep Emir Johnson

4. City Manager, re: CITY COUNCIL/STAFF COMMENTS
  Council Member Kassakhian asked staff to provide a report on banning mylar balloons and
  to address its concerns. Seconded by Brotman.

  Council Member Brotman attended the Arroyo Verdugo Communities Joint Powers Authority

  06 02 20
  SP CC
   Meeting and provided his report. At that meeting, he was appointed as a representative to
  the SCAG Energy and Environment Committee. He asked staff to provide a report on setting
  up a Sustainability Commission in conjunction of hiring a Chief Sustainability Officer.
  Seconded by Kassakhian.

  Mayor Agajanian provided his comments on the police brutality that happened in
  Minneapolis that caused the death of Mr. George Floyd. He read some parts of a report from
  the US Department of Justice and NY Police Department on how to treat an arrested
  person. Police Chief Carl Povilaitis will provide a presentation at the 6pm Council Meeting.

5. City Clerk, re: Minutes of the Special City Council Meetings of May 5, 2020 (9am and
  3pm) and May 12, 2020 (9am) and Regular City Council Meetings of May 5, 2020 and
  May 12, 2020
  Moved:  Devine  Seconded:  Najarian
  Vote as Follows
  Ayes:  Brotman, Devine, Kassakhian, Najarian, Agajanian
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  None

6. Public Works, re: Colorado Street and Columbus Avenue Rehabilitation Project

  Staff Comment:
  Yazdan Emrani, Director of Public Works

  a. Motion awarding a Construction Contract to Hardy and Harper, Inc. in the amount of
  $2,150,000, approving a 10% reserve for contingency, rejecting all other bids; and
  authorizing the City Manager to execute the contract
  Moved:  Najarian  Seconded:  Brotman
  Vote as Follows
  Ayes:  Brotman, Devine, Kassakhian, Najarian, Agajanian
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  None

  b. Resolution 20-64 Appropriating $2,428,800, Specifications No. 3629, CFDA No. 20.205
  Moved:  Najarian  Seconded:  Brotman
  Vote as Follows
  Ayes:  Brotman, Devine, Kassakhian, Najarian, Agajanian
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  None

  06 02 20
  SP CC
 7. City Attorney, re: Denial and Findings: 340 N. Central Avenue - Stage I & II
